name: Protest Simulator
detailed_description:
"The streets have lost their silence. Barricades are up. Voices are rising. The protest has begun.

In Protest Simulator, your only goal is to make your voice heard. Everything and everyone in the city wants to silence you. Police, riot trucks, barricades, tear gas... Do whatever it takes to shout one more slogan, throw one more molotov, take one more step.

Protest Simulator draws you into a world full of struggle with its growing yearly content, tactical gameplay, and dynamic urban environments. Each update brings new city zones, new protest styles, and new suppression tactics. With improved graphics, AI, and environments, every protest tells a different story.

Some of the key features and updates in the game:

  • Community-supported route editor and procedurally generated urban zones

  • Scenario modes and free roam options

  • A suppression system with riot control tools like riot trucks (TOMA), police drones, and barricades

  • Various tools for protesters: stones, slogans, molotovs

  • A megaphone and slogan system to influence crowds

  • Escape routes, hidden passages, and safe zones

  • Advanced sound design: chants, sirens, police warnings

  • Realistic day-night cycle and dynamic weather

  • Media impact and public reaction shaped by your in-game decisions

  • Steam achievements and customizable character appearance

  • 2025 Update: media propaganda mechanics, livestream invasions, and surveillance camera systems

...and much more is waiting for you.

CHOOSE YOUR SIDE

Be the police, maintain order...
Or be the protester, set the streets on fire.

Equip your shield, ready your baton, and take control of the riot truck. All it takes is one command to disperse the crowd.
Or put on your mask, pick your slogan, craft your molotovs. The more the system pushes, the stronger the resistance grows.
This city will reshape itself every night.
So which side are you on?

BREAK THE ORDER

Turn the streets into your playground.

Transform abandoned shops into safe houses and produce molotov cocktails.

In the shadows of the city, strike at the heart of the system — this is your revolution now.

STAY ALIVE

Chaos rules the city. Each night brings a new threat, a new uprising.

Stay alert. Identify those rallying crowds with slogans.

Find the ones hiding in dark corners, neutralize those crafting molotovs.

The riot truck is ready — one button, one command, and everything collapses.

The order is clear: maintain public safety and crush the resistance.

In this city, the protector of order… is you.

short_description: Choose your side in the tense streets; resist as a protester or intervene as a police officer. Build barricades, throw stones, restore order. Order or freedom the choice is yours.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon R7 260X
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • VR Support: Not supported
  • Additional Notes: Minimum supported resolution is 720p
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8192 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • VR Support: Not supported
  • Additional Notes: Recommended for smoother experience at 1080p resolution

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 12 Monterey or later
  • Processor: Apple M1 / Intel Core i5
  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple GPU / Intel Iris Plus
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Built-in audio is sufficient
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 13 Ventura or later
  • Processor: Apple M1 or later (M2, M3) / Intel i7
  • Memory: 8192 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple GPU / Radeon Pro 560X
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Built-in audio is sufficient
  • Additional Notes: Recommended for 1080p experience on Retina display devices
